capabilities: Convert a .ctd CherryTree XML file into Markdown notes in nested folders
Preview the node tree with note and image counts plus warnings
Convert rich text, headings, code boxes, tables, node and web links
Extract embedded PNG images into the destination attachments folder
Import frontmatter tags, parent index notes and a selected subtree with Pro
extras: Freemium: tags/properties, parent index notes and subtree selection need Pro via a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors payment; the free core import runs without any account. Limits: 25 MB file size, 10,000 nodes, 100 tree levels; .ctb (SQLite) and encrypted files must be exported to .ctd first. The destination folder must not already exist.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring in notes from a CherryTree XML export, so users must convert the node tree, rich text and links by hand.

relations.evidence: Move an unencrypted CherryTree XML document into an Obsidian vault.

summary: Import converter that turns an unencrypted CherryTree XML document into nested Markdown notes with folders, links, tables, code blocks and PNG images.
